title: Choose the visual world
question: Pinned: the first viewport has to show the product. The world is chrome; a clean phone-in-hand or office screenshot carries jobs, capture, and Xero-stays. Headline names the service. Too much decoration that does not connect is out. Same interesting worlds, translated.

options.label: Engineering Title Block
options.lineage: AS and ISO drawing sheets, revision clouds, issue stamps
options.thesis: A working drawing as chrome around a real office jobs screen and a small field phone; the sheet names the operations set, the screenshot proves it.
options.viewport: Quiet drawing-sheet chrome and a cobalt title block with Book a yard visit. Dominant: a clean desktop jobs/costing screenshot. A small phone in a work-worn hand shows docket photo capture. Headline: We build the job system the ute will actually use.
options.risk: If the screenshot looks like SimPRO, it collapses into the category standard; if the drawing gets busy again, the product disappears.

raised.raise: The product shot is the subject. The drawing is the frame. One headline names the service.

options.label: NCR Job Card
options.lineage: triplicate docket books and numbered job cards
options.thesis: The card is the page; a clean phone in a work-worn hand is the proof: photograph the docket, land it on the job, draft Xero.
options.viewport: A quieter job-card layout: headline We build the job system the ute will actually use; the large region is a dusty hand holding a phone showing job + docket photo + Draft to Xero; Book a yard visit on the issue line.
options.risk: The hand/phone can turn into a stock ad; keep the screen simple and custom, not an App Store product.

options.label: Yard Office Whiteboard
options.lineage: morning dispatch boards in South West yards
options.thesis: The board is atmosphere; a tablet on the rail shows the live job list the office actually runs.
options.viewport: Sparse whiteboard chrome, one headline, a clean tablet or laptop on the tray showing jobs/plant/costing. Book a yard visit is the magnet. No crowded marker columns competing with the UI.
options.risk: A tablet on a whiteboard can still look like a SaaS ad if the UI is generic.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Sit next to SimPRO, Tradify, and AroFlo: the product screenshot leads, the world does not.
canonCard.viewport: A dark SaaS hero, a job-app screenshot, three feature columns, and Book a yard visit in the header.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from those three by design.
